label: late original-phase steps of sequences starting with i
explanation: Fires only in the original (input) phase, at steps 3-8, peaking at steps 4-5. It never fires at steps 0-2, on <DEL>, or in the copy phase. About 75% of activation mass is in sequences whose first token is i, and another 12% in sequences starting with a. The predicate (original phase, t>=3, first token i) gets 73% recall and 75% mass recall on dev, but precision is only 2.5%: most i-initial sequences never activate it. Activation is more likely when the prefix contains tokens from {m, x, h, 3, 1}. Requiring two or more of these raises precision only to about 12% (F1 0.19), so whatever combination of history actually gates the feature is not captured. Activations are weak (mean 0.13 vs max 0.27), and the largest ones occur in i-initial sequences with m/x/1 at position 1, often on several consecutive steps. Mostly fires on the first occurrence of the input token (in_first, 88% of mass).

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: orig0=i (+7.86), orig0=a (+4.92), orig1=m (+3.55), orig1=x (+3.35), orig1=1 (+3.35), orig0=s (+3.24). Lower it: orig_idx=-1 (-6.60), correct=1 (-5.50), prev3_tok=- (-5.23), in_tok=l (-3.20).
